text:
Priya (People Ops): Heads up — new hire Samir Patel arriving Monday. Hes remote but flying in and asked for laptop delivery to his hotel. Also flagged: his passport expired; says he has a Canadian PR card and provincial health card. Q: can we do I-9 with PR card + notary remote if needed?

Jo (Recruiter): Samir prefers an in-person drop-in if possible. He can do 11:00am at HQ. Asked for Hindi interpreter for onboarding overview.

Lina (Onboarding): We can accept Canadian PR (List A) — that clears I-9. Expired passport won't work. For remote fallback we use NotaryNow (vendor) but note: remote notaries can't perform I-9 if candidate is outside US at signing; Samir will be in SF so OK. Please get photos uploaded to secure portal by EOD Fri.

Ben (Hiring Manager): Ill block 11:00 on my calendar and join for a quick intro. If PR card works we should be able to start payroll provisioning same day (pending SSN).

Background Check Desk: FYI our vendor flags international addresses. Without SSN, ID-only verification will go through but background vendor may add extra doc requests. Samir should sign the consent today to avoid delays.

Priya (People Ops): Plan: 1) Book 11:00 I-9 drop-in at HQ with Hindi interpreter booked, 2) IT will prep laptop for same-day pickup with AUP link to sign before handoff, 3) If Samir cant make, use NotaryNow remote I-9 and have him bring original PR card to notary session.

IT-bot: Shipping options: we can ship to hotel; please use exact hold-for label. If pickup instead, well hold in HQ secure desk for 24h. Also will kick off asset tag and VPN profile. Please note: require AUP signed before provisioning.

Jo (Recruiter): Samir prefers hotel delivery but asked to avoid signature requirement at check-in (worries about front desk hold). Suggested: hold-for pickup at front desk with mobile verification.

Priya (People Ops): Ok will instruct IT to label for front desk guest pickup and include Samirs mobile. Lina ten confirm translator and send secure upload link for PR card + secondary ID (provincial card or drivers license).

Lina (Onboarding): Added 11:00 event with interpreter and fallback NotaryNow URL in invite. Also attached checklist in invite body:

``` 
1) Upload photo of Canadian PR card to secure portal (front/back)
2) Upload secondary government photo ID (provincial driver license or health card)
3) Sign electronic consent for background check
4) Complete AUP link before laptop pickup
```

NotaryNow-bot: If remote session needed, candidate must have the original PR card present for the notary and show it on camera. Sessions available 8am-8pm PST. Link: https://notarynow.example/schedule

Background Check Desk: Once consent is signed and PR card verified, well mark SSN pending and continue with identity-based checks. Expect 48-72h for international address cases.

Ben (Hiring Manager): Great, Ill message Samir now to confirm 11:00 and hotel pickup preference. Thanks team :thumbsup:
